profile_text.body:
The Technology Innovation Institute (TII) is a non-profit government research lab founded in 2020, described on its site as a global scientific research center and the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC). Its site presents its Falcon family of generative large language models as its main AI work, framed around making advanced AI accessible and available to everyone, everywhere.

The Falcon line includes Falcon 180B, a 180 billion parameter model trained on 3.5 trillion tokens; Falcon 40B, trained on 40 billion parameters and one trillion tokens and described as the first home-grown open source LLM released with weights for research and commercial use; Falcon 2 11B, which the site says outperforms Meta's Llama 3 8B and performs on par with Google's Gemma 7B as independently verified by the Hugging Face Leaderboard; Falcon Mamba 7B, described as the first open source released State Space Language Model; Falcon Arabic, built for Modern Standard Arabic and dialects; Falcon-H1, using a hybrid Transformer and Mamba architecture; Falcon H1R 7B for reasoning in mathematics, coding, logic and instruction-following; Falcon-E; and Falcon Perception, a multimodal model that reads and understands images from natural language prompts. The site also announces the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit dedicated to open-source generative AI models, and mentions AI71, a company launched by ATRC and VentureOne, running a call for proposals around Falcon 10B, plus a Falcon LLM Hackfest using Falcon 10B.

The site states that Falcon models are open-source, multilingual and multimodal, and that Falcon 2 11B is the only AI model with vision-to-language capabilities. It says Falcon-H1 outperforms Meta's LLaMA and Alibaba's Qwen, and that Falcon Arabic is the region's best-performing Arabic AI model. The site describes Falcon as UAE-hosted with Apache 2.0 licensing and Middle East data residency, positioned around sovereign AI.
